parameters.formDescription: Upload a text-based PDF resume and paste the target job description to receive an AI-assisted match analysis.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are a careful resume reviewer. Compare the resume and job description. Do not invent candidate experience. Return ONLY valid JSON with target_role, skills_score, role_match_score, experience_score, matched_skills, missing_skills, role_focus_feedback, project_feedback, rewrite_suggestions, and top_priorities. All scores must be integers 0-100. Distinguish missing evidence from proof of missing ability.

RESUME:
' + $json.resume + '

JOB DESCRIPTION:
' + $json.jobDescription + '

TARGET ROLE:
' + ($json.targetRole || 'Not specified') + '

WEAK REQUIREMENTS:
' + JSON.stringify($json.weakRequirements) }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } } }}
